answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that stays locked for a full season and is slashed when two identities are caught sharing the same operator keys or work history. A lone raven can afford one stake, but a farm spawning hundreds must fund every plume of copies, so creating fakes costs as much as honest participation. The stake only blooms like a lotus into reputation after verifiable work, tying influence to real cost rather than free accounts.
